questions.q: In a certain code language, 'NOSTRIL' is written as 'TSRONLI', and 'PLAY' is written as 'YPLA'. How will 'FLUIDITY' be written in that language?
questions.s:
The logic followed here is:

  • NOSTRIL
    • Alphabetical order of letters: T > S > R > O > N > L > I
    • Therefore, code = TSRONLI
  • PLAY
    • Alphabetical order of letters: Y > P > L > A
    • Therefore, code = YPLA
  • FLUIDITY
    • Alphabetical order of letters: Y > U > T > L > I = I > F > D
    • Therefore, code = YUTLIIFD

Hence, 'YUTLIIFD' is the correct answer.
